name: 3F-NEB
summary: 3-Fluoro-N-ethylbuphedrone (3F-NEB) is a substituted cathinone derivative with stimulant effects which has been sold as a designer drug. It was first identified in Sweden in 2021.

pharmacology.text: In vivo, 3F-NEB acts as a potent inhibitor of the dopamine transporter, exhibiting more than 100-fold selectivity over the serotonin transporter.
